title: E2E Pipeline Test Discovery
summary: This is a mock discovery to test the end-to-end pipeline from outbox through gatekeeper validation.
details: The full pipeline includes: 1) File shim polling inbox, 2) Task submission to gateway, 3) Response written to outbox, 4) Gatekeeper validation (Layer 1), 5) Haiku review (Layer 2), 6) Routing to valid/ or quarantine/.
